services.name: fishing trip
services.desc: Welcome to our state-of-the-art facility designed to elevate your fishing and boating experience! Our modern space offers top-notch amenities and services tailored for anglers and boating enthusiasts. Our friendly and knowledgeable Charter Reservations staff are ready to assist with any needs you may have, from booking spots on inshore, nearshore, or offshore charter boats to offering expert advice. Inside the Fishing Center, you’ll find a fully stocked bait and tackle shop by Oceans East, featuring top brands to ensure a successful day on the water. blurb: Guests book fishing charters on a fleet of boats for inshore, nearshore, offshore, and specialty trips such as oyster and dolphin tours. Make-up charters allow individuals to share a boat and split costs. Captains provide all fishing gear, bait, and tackle; guests bring personal items and food.
extraNote: Deposits due in advance; remaining balance due in cash or credit card prior to departure or upon completion · Refunds only issued if trip is canceled by captain or Oregon Inlet Fishing Center due to weather, mechanical issues, or participant changes · No refund if no fish are caught during trip · Parties must check in at least 30 minutes prior to departure · Captains reserve right to assign another party to boat and forfeit deposit if party does not exist · Credit card transactions incur a 3% processing fee; 5% fee on credit card refunds non-weather related · 8770 Oregon Inlet Road, Nags Head, NC 27959, at the North end of the Marc Basnight Bridge
